newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD HEPTATHLON CHAMPION BRAUN.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD HEPTATHLON CHAMPION BRAUN.

text.p: Profile of Sabine Braun, who won the world heptathlon final on Monday.
Has competed in the last four world championships, winning gold in 1991 in Tokyo.

A disastrous long jump in the 1992 Olympics cost her the silver medal. She won the European championships in 1994 but fell on hard times after that, failing to finish the 1995 world championships and ending seventh at last year's Olympics.
Bounced back before coming to Athens with a year's best of 6,787 points.
